title: Hearty X-tra Rich Filipino Macaroni Kaldereta
description: A creamy, herbal, and nostalgic Filipino dish made with macaroni, en-croute, and featuring a rich, flavorful sauce. Perfect for a comforting dinner or special occasion.

ingredients.name: Ground Pork
ingredients.notes: you can use beef or a combination of meats

instructions: Cook the macaroni according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large Dutch oven, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground pork and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the fish sauce (if using) and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the cooked macaroni, chopped onion, and basil. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the Dutch oven to a preheated oven and bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
